description: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of factual errors across different question-answering systems, namely HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, Musique, and IIRC, when evaluated with three different QA systems: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, which is a count of the instances where the answers provided by the QA systems were incorrect. The horizontal axis lists the four question-answering systems. Each system is represented by a group of three bars, each bar corresponding to one of the QA systems. The bars are color-coded, with NoR QA in yellow, OneR QA in red, and IRCoT QA in blue. The values on the bars indicate the number of factual errors for each system, with the shortest bar representing the fewest errors and the tallest bar representing the most errors. The chart shows that HotpotQA has the lowest number of errors for NoR QA and IRCoT QA, while 2WikiMQA has the highest number of errors for NoR QA. Musique and IIRC have a similar number of errors across the three QA systems, with Musique having slightly more errors for OneR QA and IRCoT QA. The chart does not provide any additional information on the nature of the errors or the context in which they occurred.
